name: A Bundle of Trouble
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, A Bundle of Trouble begins with timber left in the woods and a deadline near. Supervisor Raelen needs the cut wood brought back before the shipment falls behind.

sections.title: A Looming Deadline
sections.body: Supervisor Raelen has a shipment of timber due soon. Eastvale Logging Camp cuts wood for Stormwind, and her crew has fallen behind schedule. With the deadline close, Raelen needs the timber sent on its way.

sections.title: Predators in the Timber
sections.body: Wolves and bears north of the camp have driven the woodcutters away from bundles of cut timber. The workers left the wood where it lay. Raelen cannot wait for guards to clear the area, so she asks you to bring the bundles back to camp.

faq.answer: Supervisor Raelen manages the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. She oversees the woodcutters and the timber shipments bound for Stormwind and nearby settlements.

faq.q: Why is the wood abandoned in the woods?
faq.answer: The laborers had cut and bundled the logs before bears and wolves drove them from the clearing. They fled to camp without the wood.

faq.q: Why does Raelen mention Deputy Rainer?
faq.answer: Raelen says she contacted Deputy Rainer about the predators. He is stationed at Westbrook Garrison, far across Elwynn Forest, so the message may have traveled through the guards, or local authority may be stretched thin.
Eastvale Logging Camp sends timber throughout the kingdom for rebuilding towns and strengthening palisades and bridges. A missed deadline can hurt Elwynn's economy and delay construction.

faq.q: Why can't the loggers collect the wood themselves?
faq.answer: The woodcutters are laborers who fell trees, not fighters trained to face predators. Wolves and bears drove them off, and they will not return to the thicket unarmed.

faq.q: Where can the bundles of wood be found?
faq.answer: The bundles lie in the woods just north of Eastvale Logging Camp, where the laborers were working before local beasts drove them away.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can help keep Stormwind's rebuilding and regional outposts supplied with lumber from Eastvale.
As a hunter, you can track through predator-filled groves and face the local beasts while recovering the supplies.
